summary.zh: 手机网页端现在会立即清除一次性登录凭据，并在登录后恢复失败时彻底撤销半初始化状态；桌面端也能从缺失的会话身份中恢复，而不再静默拒绝发送。
summary.en: Mobile web now clears one-shot sign-in credentials immediately and fully rolls back failed post-login recovery. Desktop also recovers from missing chat identity instead of silently refusing sends.

title.zh: 登录失败后不再保留凭据或半初始化状态
title.en: Failed Mobile sign-in no longer retains credentials or partial runtime state

summary.zh: 手机网页提交访问密钥或密码后会立即清空对应输入；用户名仍保留以便重试。若登录成功但会话恢复失败，应用会中止待处理请求、断开 WebSocket、清空已认证运行时，并撤销刚创建的网页会话后返回登录页。
summary.en: Mobile clears an access key or password immediately after submission while retaining the username for retry. If sign-in succeeds but session recovery fails, it aborts pending requests, disconnects the WebSocket, clears authenticated runtime state, revokes the newly created web session, and returns to sign-in.

sources.title: fix(mobile): clear rejected credentials and failed runtime

title.zh: 桌面端可恢复缺失的会话身份

summary.zh: 当新会话草稿或现有会话缺少可发送所需的身份信息时，桌面端会修复可恢复状态、保留编辑内容与附件，并在无法自动修复时显示可操作的错误提示。文本、语音和附件发送共用同一套恢复路径。
summary.en: When a new draft or existing chat lacks the identity required to send, Desktop repairs recoverable state while preserving composer content and attachments, and shows an actionable error when automatic repair is impossible. Text, voice, and attachment sends share the same recovery path.

sources.title: fix(desktop): recover missing session identity (Approach B) (#3)
